description: Covered deep-tracked names. ETF entries removed 2026-08-19: XEG CN, RIO FP, GDXJ US were hidden from every UI surface by isDisplayable() (which filters securityType==='etf'), so keeping them in this list produced no visible signal and permanently skipped them from /sweep. To follow an ETF, use direct /s/<ticker> URLs — those still resolve for benchmarking purposes. If ETF coverage becomes a first-class feature, revisit isDisplayable + this file together.
